label: Agency Workspace Pro
summary: Advanced agency portfolio workspaces with scoped branding, client-facing views, resource links and coordinated handoffs. Optional support-system connectors can enrich workflows without becoming the source of technical ownership.
core_boundary: Core keeps customer/reseller lifecycle, ordinary delegation, plans, quotas and essential UI. This module adds portfolio productivity and branding within existing scope; no paid workspace can hide operator identity, weaken security messages or become necessary for client hosting access.
acceptance: Resolve workspace/client/resource relationships through Core ownership and reseller ceilings rather than copying an authority ledger.
Apply branding only through reviewed declarative assets while retaining security, consent and operator context.
Test client isolation, staff revocation and cross-workspace links across all embedded views.
Preserve language/accessibility fallback and usable Core navigation when the workspace is disabled.
Keep support records and customer data exportable under explicit retention and handoff policy.
